exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you met a friend at a café or restaurant.
Some people prefer to meet friends in cafés or restaurants, while others prefer to meet at home. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about opening a café that allows customers to work on laptops for many hours without buying much food or drink. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is considering banning cafés from placing tables on sidewalks because they block pedestrians. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
